page.overview:
Who is Fitzsimmons Family?

The Fitzsimmons Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Millie Fitzsimmons from Count the Ways, the third story of Fazbear Frights 1: Into the Pit.

Millie Fitzsimmons is the main protagonist of Count the Ways, and later reappeared in the final Stitchwraith Stingers from Fazbear Frights #11.

The unnamed grandfather of the Fitzsimmons family is the grandfather of Millie, Cameron, and Hayden. He is the secondary main character of Count the Ways. He is a collector of mechanical objects and owns an old Victorian house.

Jeff Fitzsimmons is Millie's father and Audrey's husband. He is said to be rather ridiculous, flighty, and impractical. Millie calls her parents ridiculous, flighty, and impractical. Jeff and Audrey are considered jokes in the town, famous for their tendency to enthusiastically start projects and then abandon them. When Millie was ten, her parents had bought a run-down but once-beautiful colonial house and attempted to refurbish it, but after three months they ran out of time, money, and energy. As a result, the living room and kitchen were brand new but the bedrooms and bathroom were still run-down. Jeff had also begun repainting the front and one side of the house but gave up due to how expensive and exhausting painting was, as well as not liking ladders.
